usage.callShape: GET https://stableanalytics.dev/api/site/sources?site_id={site_id}&period={period}&limit={limit} with a Sign-In-With-X request header set to base64(JSON.stringify(SIWE payload)). No USDC payment ($0, identity-only).
usage.outputShape: body.referrers[].{referrer, visits}, body.utm_sources[].{utm_source, visits}, body.utm_campaigns[].{utm_campaign, visits}. For untracked domains: HTTP 404 {success:false, error:'Site not found'}.
quirks: SIWX-only endpoint: $0, identity-gated, no USDC payment — accepts[] in the 402 challenge is empty.
Before each call, probe the exact target URL (incl. query string) with a plain GET to receive a FRESH 402 challenge; the nonce is single-use, so re-probe for every new authenticated request.

The 'uri' field in the SIWE JSON payload must exactly match the full request URL including the query string (e.g. https://stableanalytics.dev/api/site/sources?site_id=example.com&period=7d&limit=100).
Use 'issuedAt' from the SIWE signer output, not from the 402 challenge.
chainId in the JSON payload must be the eip155 string form 'eip155:8453', not the numeric integer; generate the signature with chain_id 8453.
Required query param: site_id. Optional: period (24h|7d|30d, default 7d), limit (1-500, default 100).

Untracked/unowned domains return HTTP 404 {success:false, error:'Site not found'} — this is a data-availability result, NOT an auth failure or broken endpoint. Tested with example.com which is untracked.
Header name is the literal 'Sign-In-With-X' header carrying base64(JSON.stringify(payload)).
usage.guide: StableAnalytics /api/site/sources is a free, SIWX (Sign-In-With-X) identity-gated web-analytics endpoint returning traffic-source breakdowns (referrers, utm_sources, utm_campaigns) for a tracked site. To call it: first probe the exact full URL (with query string) via a plain GET to get a fresh 402 challenge, read extensions['sign-in-with-x'].info (domain, uri, version, chainId, type, nonce, issuedAt, expirationTime, statement), sign it with the SIWE tool (chain_id 8453, chainId rendered as 'eip155:8453', issuedAt from the signer), base64-encode JSON.stringify(payload), and send it as the 'Sign-In-With-X' header. Cost is always $0. Required query param is site_id (the domain you want analytics for); period and limit are optional. Read results at body.referrers[], body.utm_sources[], body.utm_campaigns[]. A 404 {error:'Site not found'} means that site_id is not tracked, not that the endpoint is broken — query a domain you own/track for real data.
